exposure: Neighborhood disadvantage (measured by area deprivation index)
cohort: 16,351 people who underwent index cesarean deliveries between 2008 and 2017 at a single center.
finding: People from highly disadvantaged neighborhoods had twice the odds of receiving general anesthesia for cesarean deliveries compared to those from no disadvantage neighborhoods.
mod_finding: People from disadvantaged neighborhoods were more likely to receive general anesthesia for cesarean deliveries.
